push-event runs failing on get-diff-action ref resolution

get-diff-action diffs against a pull/<n>/merge ref that only exists for
pull_request events. On a push (e.g. the post-merge commit landing on
master/development) that ref is absent, so the action exits 128, fails the
"Check if client files changed" gate, and the build + stable tests job is
skipped (needs: run_client).

Only run the file-change filter for pull_request events; on push always set
is_set=true so the post-merge run exercises the full suite. PR-event behaviour
(skip build when no py/yml files changed) is unchanged.

which meant the run never printed the failure summary. Add pytest-timeout with a
120s per-test SIGALRM timeout so any single hung test fails on its own and the
suite continues, surfacing all real failures in one completed run.

<p dir="auto">Hummingbot is an open-source framework that helps you design and deploy automated trading strategies, or <strong>bots</strong>, that can run on many centralized or decentralized exchanges. Over the past year, Hummingbot users have generated over $34 billion in trading volume across 140+ unique trading venues.</p>
<p dir="auto">The Hummingbot codebase is free and publicly available under the Apache 2.0 open-source license. Our mission is to <strong>democratize high-frequency trading</strong> by creating a global community of algorithmic traders and developers that share knowledge and contribute to the codebase.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Exchange Connectors</h2><a id="user-content-exchange-connectors" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Exchange Connectors" href="#exchange-connectors"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Hummingbot connectors standardize REST and WebSocket API interfaces to different types of exchanges, enabling you to build sophisticated trading strategies that can be deployed across many exchanges with minimal changes.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Connector Types</h3><a id="user-content-connector-types" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Connector Types" href="#connector-types"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">We classify exchange connectors into three main categories:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>CLOB CEX</strong>: Centralized exchanges with central limit order books that take custody of your funds. Connect via API keys.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Spot</strong>: Trading spot markets</li>
<li><strong>Perpetual</strong>: Trading perpetual futures markets</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>CLOB DEX</strong>: Decentralized exchanges with on-chain central limit order books. Non-custodial, connect via wallet keys.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Spot</strong>: Trading spot markets on-chain</li>
<li><strong>Perpetual</strong>: Trading perpetual futures on-chain</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p dir="auto"><strong>AMM DEX</strong>: Decentralized exchanges using Automated Market Maker protocols. Non-custodial, connect via Gateway middleware.</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Router</strong>: DEX aggregators that find optimal swap routes</li>
<li><strong>AMM</strong>: Traditional constant product (x*y=k) pools</li>
<li><strong>CLMM</strong>: Concentrated Liquidity Market Maker pools with custom price ranges</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
